{"command":"cd /testbed && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('pyasn1/type/univ.py')
s = p.read_text()
old = '''    def __getitem__(self, i):
        if i.__class__ is slice:
            length = len(self._value) - 1
            if i > length or i < 0:
                raise IndexError('bit index out of range')
            return (self._value >> (length - i)) & 1
        else:
            return self.clone([self[x] for x in range(*i.indices(len(self)))])
'''
new = '''    def __getitem__(self, i):
        if isinstance(i, slice):
            return self.clone([self[x] for x in range(*i.indices(len(self)))])
        else:
            if i < 0:
                i += len(self)
            if i < 0 or i >= len(self):
                raise IndexError('bit index out of range')
            return (self._value >> (len(self) - i - 1)) & 1
'''
assert old in s
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, 1))
p = Path('tests/type/test_univ.py')
s = p.read_text()
old = '''    def testGetItem(self):
        assert self.b.clone("'A98A'H")[0] == 1
        assert self.b.clone("'A98A'H")[1] == 0
        assert self.b.clone("'A98A'H")[2] == 1
'''
new = '''    def testGetItem(self):
        bit_string = self.b.clone("'A98A'H")
        assert bit_string[0] == 1
        assert bit_string[1] == 0
        assert bit_string[2] == 1
        assert bit_string[-1] == 0
        assert bit_string[1:4] == (0, 1, 0)
        for index in (len(bit_string), -len(bit_string) - 1):
            try:
                bit_string[index]
            except IndexError:
                pass
            else:
                raise AssertionError('out-of-range bit index accepted')
'''
assert old in s
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, 1))

python - <<'PY'
from pyasn1.type import univ
bs = univ.BitString("'A98A'H")
assert [bs[i] for i in range(3)] == [1, 0, 1]
assert bs[1:4] == (0, 1, 0)
assert bs[-1] == 0
for i in (len(bs), -len(bs)-1):
    try:
        bs[i]
    except IndexError:
        continue
    raise AssertionError(i)
print('reproduction and edge cases passed')
